Project Overview

Help shape the future of AI in Brazil!

We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market.

We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Games & Puzzles to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese.

Suitable backgrounds may include Game Designers & Systems Architects: professionals with senior-level experience in mechanics design, economy balancing, or level design for AAA, indie, or mobile gaming; Narrative Designers & Game Writers: Experts in branching narratives, world-building, and character development specifically for interactive media and RPGs; Puzzle Designers & Ludologists: creators of complex logic puzzles, escape room scenarios, or cryptic challenges with a deep understanding of difficulty scaling and player flow; Tabletop & Board Game Developers: Designers or publishers of modern board games, card games, or tabletop RPGs (TTRPGs) with expertise in physical components and ruleset clarity; Game User Research (GUR) & UX Specialists: Experts in player psychology, playtesting methodology, and human-computer interaction (HCI) within gaming environments; Esports Analysts & Professional Players: Individuals with a deep strategic understanding of competitive meta-games, high-level mechanics, and professional tournament structures; Software Engineers & Technical Directors: Senior developers specializing in game engines (Unity, Unreal), physics simulations, or AI behavior within gaming systems; Gamification Experts: Consultants who apply game-design thinking and play mechanics to non-game contexts like education, health, or corporate training.

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

  • Design content that requires critical thinking, nuance, and multi-step reasoning
  • Ensure clarity, precision, and consistently high writing quality in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Follow detailed project guidelines and meet agreed timelines and quality standards
    •

• Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field

We are looking for AI Voice Recording Contributors to join a Chinese Simplified voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. 
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 8 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Chinese Simplified voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. 
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 8 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do
- Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).

- Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.

- Speak using your natural dialect and accent.

- Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.

- Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.

- Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For
- Native-level fluency in Chinese Simplified.

- Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.

- Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.

- Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.

- Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.

- Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.

- Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements
- Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.

- Computer microphone or headset with microphone.

- Reliable internet connection.

- Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer
- Flexible, remote work.

- Timely and reliable payments.

- Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.

- Access to future language and AI-related projects.

- A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

We are looking for  AI Linguistic Quality Evaluator to assess how effectively an AI application performs in Bengali for a short collaboration.

  • Job Type: Freelance
  • Location: Remote from Singapore
  • Work Schedule: Flexible
  • Start Date: Immediately
  • Duration: Approximately 10-15 total hours (around 5 hours per day)
  • Rate: 24 USD/hour
Help Shape the Future of AI
Are you a student, recent graduate, stay-at-home parent, gig worker, or professional seeking flexible remote work? Are you interested in shaping the development and safety of today’s AI models?
 
What You’ll Do
  • Evaluate and audit multilingual AI-generated responses for accuracy, helpfulness, and cultural relevance
  • Review assigned batches of AI outputs against localized quality guidelines.
  • Score responses and assign pass/fail ratings based on defined quality criteria.
  • Compare multiple AI-generated responses for the same prompt and rank them based on quality.

What We Are Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in the assigned language/locale.
  • Must be currently located in Singapore.
  • Advanced English proficiency to understand written instructions and guidelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate content objectively.
  • Comfortable assessing content quality, accuracy, and cultural appropriateness.
  • Willingness to complete ID Verification.
  • Must pass the required Language Assessment.
  • Available to start immediately due to an urgent project requirement.
What We Offer
 
  •  Flexible schedule
  •  Opportunity to earn extra income
  •  Timely payments
  • The job is ideal for students, part-timers, or stay-at-home parents

text:
We are looking for AI Linguistic Evaluators to assess how effectively an AI application performs in Telugu for a short collaboration.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Remote from the United States
Work Schedule: Flexible
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: Approximately 10-15 total hours (around 5 hours per day)
Rate: 18 USD/hour
Equipment Required: Access to at least one personal device running iOS, Android, Windows, or macOS

Help Shape the Future of AI
Are you a native-level speaker of Telugu with strong English skills and a keen eye for language quality? Join a remote AI project where you'll evaluate AI-generated content, assess linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, and help improve next-generation AI systems. Ideal for professionals with experience in linguistics, translation, interpretation, language teaching, writing, journalism, proofreading, content review, localization, or other language-focused fields.

What You’ll Do:
- Interacting with an AI assistant in your target language.

- Translating provided prompts from English into your target language and using them to interact with the AI application.

- Evaluating the quality of AI-generated responses according to project guidelines.

- Assessing localization quality, including linguistic accuracy, naturalness, and cultural appropriateness.

- Providing structured evaluations and feedback following the project instructions and quality standards.

What We’re Looking For:
- Native-level fluency in Telugu

- Excellent command of grammar, spelling, linguistic nuances, and cultural context of the target language

Ability to accurately translate prompts from English into the target language

Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Languages, Philology, Literature, or a related field, or

Minimum 3 years of professional experience in language-related work

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines

Ability to independently evaluate AI-generated content and provide consistent quality assessments

Comfortable working with structured evaluation criteria and quality standards

Ability to work independently and deliver accurate, objective feedback

We are looking for AI Conversation Recording Contributors to join a Lingala speech data collection project and help support the evaluation and development of the next generation of AI technologies.
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 2–4 hours daily)
Project Duration: TBC
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 8 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to evaluate and improve speech recognition and conversational AI technologies by providing spontaneous speech collected from real-life situations.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
The collected recordings, annotations, and related metadata will be used to evaluate the spontaneous speech capabilities of speech-enabled AI models. The compiled data may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

lists.content:
• Record or collect natural, spontaneous speech in accordance with the project guidelines.
  • Participate in or capture speech from approved real-life situations, such as workplace conversations or casual one-on-one discussions.

  • Annotate collected speech data according to the instructions provided.
  • Provide the required information and metadata related to each recording.

• Native-level fluency in Lingala.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target language through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording or data annotation projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail when providing annotations and recording metadata.
  • Ability to follow detailed project and recording instructions.

• Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.

  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

• Flexible, remote work.

  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Working on behalf of RWS, you will test and evaluate how our clients’ search engine responds to everyday searches from everyday people.

You:
- Inquisitive by nature with a real interest in AI.
- Have excellent skills in online research.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.
- Continually maintain quality and accuracy SLAs.
- Have the self-discipline to stick to a schedule and get the work done despite the potential distractions of a home office.
- Be a critical thinker with ability to analyze information and assess its relevance or significance.

Language: English and Italian proficiency.
Location: Switzerland (Work from Home).
Schedule: E.g. 8-20 h/week. Avg. 15 h/weekly.

Help shape the future of AI in Brazil!

We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market.

We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in History to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese.

Suitable backgrounds may include historians or historiographical researchers; professional or former academic scholars with extensive archival experience; curators or museum directors at the institutional or heritage level; cultural heritage specialists (preservation, restoration, provenance analysis); executives or senior staff at historical societies or national archives; archaeologists or site managers for major historical or excavation projects; historical analysts or journalists with deep domain-specific expertise; government officials in heritage departments, certified archivists, or authorized experts in cultural property.

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)

Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

We are looking for Generative Audio Evaluation Specialists! A great entry point into ongoing work within one of our most active AI markets!
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Remote (The Netherlands)
Work Schedule: Part-time - 10+ hours per week. Flexible - work whenever you want!
Rate: 19 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

We’re currently hiring AI Generalists to join a highly specialized evaluation project focused on testing and assessing the performance of a cutting-edge generative audio model. Your work will play an important role in identifying performance issues and providing feedback that can help improve the model.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

You will evaluate AI-generated audio for short video and text-to-audio tasks, following detailed project guidelines. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Audio Quality & Naturalness: Assess speech, background music, and sound effects for clarity, quality, and naturalness.
  • Audio-Video Alignment: Evaluate synchronization between the generated audio and video, including lip-sync and timing.
  • Caption Compliance: Check whether the generated audio accurately follows the provided text captions and task requirements.
  • Voice Quality: Evaluate whether generated voices sound natural and, where applicable, match the reference audio.
  • Evaluation & Feedback: Assign accurate scores and identify issues according to the provided evaluation guidelines.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Dutch
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listening skills
  • Ability to follow detailed evaluation guidelines consistently
  • Good understanding of spoken language, audio quality, and context
  • Reliable equipment — high-quality headphones are required
  • Ability to complete the evaluation test within 48 hours of receiving the assignment

Help Shape the Future of AI

We’re currently hiring AI Generalists to join a highly specialized evaluation project focused on testing and assessing the performance of a cutting-edge generative audio model. Your work will play an important role in identifying performance issues and providing feedback that can help improve the model.

  • Voice Quality: Evaluate whether generated voices sound natural and, where applicable, match the reference audio.
  • Evaluation & Feedback: Assign accurate scores and identify issues according to the provided evaluation guidelines.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Polish
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listening skills
  • Ability to follow detailed evaluation guidelines consistently
  • Good understanding of spoken language, audio quality, and context
  • Reliable equipment — high-quality headphones are required
  • Ability to complete the evaluation test within 48 hours of receiving the assignment

Overview:
Are you a web-savvy, search expert with a talent for finding things online by using just a few words? Do you want to influence the future of global AI search? If so, we want you on board!
Working on behalf of RWS, you will test and evaluate how our clients’ search engine responds to everyday searches from everyday people.
Using your search expertise, you will work through a variety of assignments playing a crucial part in enhancing AI data which will be used to improve the online search engine experience of our clients’ users.
 
You:
- Inquisitive by nature with a real interest in AI.
- Have excellent skills in online research.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.
- Continually maintain quality and accuracy SLAs.
- Have the self-discipline to stick to a schedule and get the work done despite the potential distractions of a home office.
- Be a critical thinker with ability to analyze information and assess its relevance or significance.

Quick overview of the flexible, part-time job:
 
Language: English and Hebrew proficiency.
Location: Israel (Work from Home).
Schedule: E.g. 8-20 h/week. Avg. 15 h/weekly.
Pay: Up to 13 USD/hour.
 
Who Should Apply: Ideal for freelancers, students, stay-at-home parents, or anyone seeking flexible remote work to improve AI models. No previous experience is required.
 
Role Description: Join RWS Group as an evaluator to enhance search engine results. Provide feedback on text, audio, images, and videos to refine AI data used by major search engines, social media sites, streaming platforms and more.

• Currently reside in Israel.

  • Reliable antivirus software to protect your computer as you surf the web.

• Flexible home-based work.
  • Work-life balance.
  • Potential side-hustle.
  • Payments via PayPal/Bank Account.
  • Access to more opportunities through our TrainAI Community.

Help shape the future of AI in Brazil!

We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market.

We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Fandoms to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. For digital-discourse profiles, relevant experience may include professional semiotics, internet culture (including political memes); social media sociology; senior-level media education, or recognized digital authorship or public commentary on viral trends.

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

Project Overview

Help shape the future of AI in Brazil!

We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market.

We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Literature & linguistics to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese.

Suitable backgrounds may include linguists & philologists: academics or researchers specializing in sociolinguistics, historical linguistics, or syntax, particularly with a focus on Brazilian Portuguese dialects and evolution; literary scholars & critics: PhDs or senior researchers in Comparative Literature, Brazilian Literature, or Literary Theory with experience in deep textual analysis and criticism; professional editors & lexicographers: senior editors from major publishing houses or experts involved in dictionary compilation and language standardization; translators & Localizers: senior literary translators or localization experts who specialize in adapting complex creative works between English and Brazilian Portuguese; creative writers & poets: Published authors or long-form writers with a deep command of narrative structure, stylistics, and creative prose; grammarians & educators: Specialized professors or textbook authors with expertise in advanced Portuguese grammar, orthography (including the CPLP standards), and discourse analysis; cultural journalists: Critics or essayists who specialize in literary reviews and contemporary cultural movements in the Lusophone world.

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

- Job Type: Freelance

- Location: Brazil (Remote) - Open to candidates in Curitiba, Porto Alegre, Florianópolis, Belo Horizonte, Campinas, Vitória, Goiânia, Recife, Fortaleza, Natal, João Pessoa, Maceió, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Brasília, including but not limited to

- Work Schedule: Part-time (10+ hours per week), fully flexible

- Rate: 26,40 USD/hour

- Start Date: Late October

- Duration: Approx. 2 months

- Develop advanced, open-ended questions grounded in realistic, real-world scenarios related to veterinary medicine, animal behavior, nutrition, and the specific conservation challenges or legal frameworks unique to the Brazilian market

- Follow detailed project guidelines and meet agreed timelines and quality standards

Use of AI tools to generate answers or questions is strictly prohibited.

PhD in a relevant field (required)

- 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field

- Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner

- Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail

- Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation

Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 20 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.

  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.

We are looking for AI Voice Recording Contributors to join a Chinese Simplified voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. 
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 5 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

lists.content:
• Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

• Native-level fluency in Chinese Simplified.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions. 
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.

• Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.

  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

• Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Overview:
Are you a web-savvy, search expert with a talent for finding things online by using just a few words? Do you want to influence the future of global AI search? If so, we want you on board!
Working on behalf of RWS, you will test and evaluate how our clients’ search engine responds to everyday searches from everyday people.
Using your search expertise, you will work through a variety of assignments playing a crucial part in enhancing AI data which will be used to improve the online search engine experience of our clients’ users.
 
You:
- Inquisitive by nature with a real interest in AI.
- Have excellent skills in online research.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.
- Continually maintain quality and accuracy SLAs.
- Have the self-discipline to stick to a schedule and get the work done despite the potential distractions of a home office.
- Be a critical thinker with ability to analyze information and assess its relevance or significance.

Quick overview of the flexible, part-time job:
 
Language: English and Chinese Traditional proficiency.
Location: Taiwan (Work from Home).
Schedule: E.g. 8-20 h/week. Avg. 15 h/weekly.
Pay: Up to 9 USD/hour.
 
Who Should Apply: Ideal for freelancers, students, stay-at-home parents, or anyone seeking flexible remote work to improve AI models. No previous experience is required.
 
Role Description: Join RWS Group as an evaluator to enhance search engine results. Provide feedback on text, audio, images, and videos to refine AI data used by major search engines, social media sites, streaming platforms and more.

lists.content:
• Currently reside in Taiwan.

  • Must pass training modules and a required test created by our client before commencing work.
  • Only one Search Quality Rater per household. 
  • Must be 18+ years old.

• Flexible home-based work.
  • Work-life balance.
  • Potential side-hustle.
  • Payments via PayPal/Bank Account.
  • Access to more opportunities through our TrainAI Community.

We are looking for AI Conversation Recording Contributors to join an Siswati speech data collection project and help support the evaluation and development of the next generation of AI technologies.
 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 2–4 hours daily)
Project Duration: TBC
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 9 USD/hour
 
 
Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to evaluate and improve speech recognition and conversational AI technologies by providing spontaneous speech collected from real-life situations.
 
 
How Your Recordings Will Be Used
The collected recordings, annotations, and related metadata will be used to evaluate the spontaneous speech capabilities of speech-enabled AI models. The compiled data may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

lists.content:
• Record or collect natural, spontaneous speech in accordance with the project guidelines.
  • Participate in or capture speech from approved real-life situations, such as workplace conversations or casual one-on-one discussions.
  • Complete individual or two-person conversational speech tasks, or participate in voice or voice-text interactions with an AI or machine-based system.
  • Annotate collected speech data according to the instructions provided.
  • Provide the required information and metadata related to each recording.

• Native-level fluency in Siswati.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target language through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording or data annotation projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail when providing annotations and recording metadata.
  • Ability to follow detailed project and recording instructions.

• Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

• Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.
